name: BallIdentifier
description: Identify any countryball from a spawn image in a second. Spawn art gallery, catch trainer, collectors list, Ballsdex stats and a dashboard for server admins. Supports multiple dexes, with community-maintained data via pull requests.

name: BallIdentifier bot
description: The Discord side of BallIdentifier: right-click a spawn → Apps → Identify. Perceptual hashing, catch stats, collections, profiles and dex reports.

name: fansuby.cc
description: A catalog of Polish anime subtitles matched to specific releases. Full-text search, moderated uploads, a public API, Stremio integration, a Discord bot and a Firefox extension.

name: WorldNotes
description: An interactive 3D globe for notes about countries. 265 countries and territories, colors, groups, profiles, JSON import/export. Everything stays in the browser, no account needed.

name: SteamRPC
description: Shows the game you're playing on Steam as your Discord Rich Presence, including Steam Rich Presence details for games that support it.

name: Verve
description: Multi-language Discord music bot with YouTube and Spotify support.
